content: Mɔ̈ɔ̈ akün unsà isal a Nzam
Atɔŋ, mɛ amàlalɔɔm, kikɔb a nsyääm a Nzam, làkäb ndür abɛ asànaa ibɔɔn a mɔ̈ɔ̈, kyà in'kyɛɛl anà kyàmupà Nzam un'sak: kya isàkal ngyamàkà a ndandaa ntɔn bɛ.
Twon lan'lab nsyääl a mɛɛn a mpal ayi, wɛɛ làkäl bàŋàbulà u nsɔɔmà a un'yɛnà ntɔn musà nsɔ̈ɔ̈l unsà ukwen a Nzam: undiir aŋàbwaŋ afàpà nde un'sak anà wàŋàkwo.

U mbwo a kab a ngway alà ban'pɛ, mɛ in'tɛn akà umwɛy umwɛy uboo a bɛ: twon lan'kal anà uyɔl aŋàsöönà anà uyɔl tii unsà undiir ayɔbà, làyɔbà mbɔɔn ntɔn mutɔn uyɔl, umwɛy ntɔn isii a làkwikilà alà kun'pɛ Nzam.
Asànaa bi ibà itiir mbɔɔn unsà ndür mwɛy, wɛɛ itiir abi byanswà kà byà isal imwɛy anki.
Kyakin, itàkal naa bi ibà mbɔɔn, bi ibà ndür mwɛy unsà Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ibàŋàtüüb amwɛy anà bumwɛy, asànaa itiir a ndür mwɛy.
Bi ibye anà an'kab mànsöön, mulab kab a ngway alà bipɛ, nkye la là kab a ngɔɔm? Wɛy bàsyääl la unsà un'tüüb anà làkwikilà.
Nà awe anà kab a isal? Wɛy nde upɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande unsà isal. Umwɛy usàkal anà kab alɔŋ, wɛy nde ulɔŋ.
Nkye wumwɛy we alà làlɛɛl? Wɛy nde ulɛɛl. Wɛy mbuur afàpà, upɛ ukɔɔn asà un'tal, mbuur asyen, ukyer anà un'kanà, mbuur afàsyääm, ukyer unsà un'sak.
Wɛy ukwen abɛ bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal bà mpem ywel. Làsi làyiiŋ akà ube, làbääb anà ubwaŋ:
- ntɔn ukwen a itɔŋ, làkäl anà ukwen mbɔɔn bɛ a bɛ, - ntɔn ibyääl, làkäl bàtàtwɛb musyäŋà baar asin,
- ntɔn isal a Mwol, làkäl ngwal unsà Dweelà, lun'syääl asànaa asɔ,
- ntɔn làkyän, làkäl unsà un'sak, - ntɔn mpay, làkäl anà nkääŋ a mpem, làsi muküünà u ngyamàkà
- ntɔn ngyal a aŋin'kyɛɛl, labay, làkäl anà un'kaay.
Làsaak baar abà bàfàlamɛɛy nkwaaŋ: lasaak, twon lasi in'küül.
Làsäŋ anà baar abà unsà un'sak, làlel anà baar bàlelà.
Làkäl anà un'tüüb a ngwal bɛ a bɛ: twon lan'kal anà ngyal a indiir an'köl an'köl, wɛɛ, wɛy bàlasyeen akà indiir a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n. Twon lan'kyey uyɔl naa bɛ làbà aŋan'yeerà.
Akà mbuur mwɛy, twon lan'fuur ube kà ikal a ube. Taaŋ lanswà, làleŋ mukyer ubwaŋ kusà a baar banswà.
Kya ipöl isàkal, naa ba ukwen abɛ, làkäl a duu anà baar banswà.
Nkween amɛ, twon lan'fuur bɛ ŋakwo ube akà ube, wɛɛ làwɛy nkyɛl a Nzam isäl, ntɔn bàsön naa: « Mwol kàtɛn naa: "Mfuur a ube yà yàmɛ, mɛ kan'kwo mufur nsyääl a umwɛy umwɛy.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa un'yiiŋ a ngye we anà ngyal, un'pɛ udyà, isàkal naa nde we anà mfyää, un'pɛ unwà. Ntɔn ngye asàkyer abun, ya yà asànaa an'kal a mbaa ngye akasaa udu a un'tswe ande." »
Abun, twon an'wɛy naa ube bàwɛl iböŋ udu a ngye, wɛɛ kal wàŋàböŋ kusà a ube mukyer ubwaŋ.
